versions.changelog:
- Initial release of onboarding-flow-designer.
- Supports systematic onboarding flow creation based on user journey maps and activation metrics.
- Automatically collects required information and recommends onboarding strategies based on product and user type.
- Generates onboarding plans in four structured phases: welcome, first win, progressive guidance, and ongoing activation.
- Defines clear activation metrics: activation rate, time-to-value, and 7-day retention.
- Provides a standardized output format for onboarding flow proposals.
